name: A Soldier's Last Letter
description: An unsent letter, folded small enough to fit in a breast pocket.
paragraphs: Mother -- if you're reading this and not me telling it to you myself, then I suppose the watch commander was right to make us write these before the march.
Don't let them bury me in my armor. Sell it, it's good steel and you'll need the coin more than the ground will need the metal. Tell Wren I said the garden needs weeding, she'll know what that means.
I'm not scared. I want you to know that. I'm just tired, and I think I'd like to rest now.
